title: Blue Cube on Table
description: A vibrant blue cube covered in white line drawings and symbols sits on a paint-splattered wooden table. The background wall displays multiple faint, floating purple cubes of varying sizes.
prompt: A realistic oil painting of a glossy bright blue cube resting on a wooden table with paint splatters. The cube is covered in white technical line drawings, small symbols and cube diagrams. In the background, numerous translucent purple cubes float in the air against a soft blue-gray wall. A few small cube fragments and paint drips are scattered on the table surface, soft atmospheric lighting, painterly style
